recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-8852 unless a future review finds a separate generated artifact that still emits the obsolete base value.
issue_request: FHIR-8852 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core correction raised against DSTU1 and applied for DSTU2. It reported that the StructureDefinition for the abstract Resource type had an invalid or incomplete StructureDefinition.base value of http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/.
initial_application: Jira comments from October 2015 state that Grahame had already corrected the issue in svn. No current git commit explicitly references FHIR-8852, consistent with the fix predating the current git source lineage.
additional_context: The current source/resource/structuredefinition-Resource.xml is active current core source and sets Resource.baseDefinition to http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Base. source/fhir.ini contains active Resource entries in type-page, normative-package, first-normative-version, and search metadata sections. Corrected community searches found no direct Zulip or Confluence reference that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative source already reflects the corrected base canonical and does not contain the obsolete malformed directory URL.
